cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Do I bring my own towel when I visit now? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The guest towel or the one that's always been mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is still on the hook. I haven't moved it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I leave, shall I hang it back there or put it with the guest laundry?

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 in-charge insertion does not sustain authority through the personal-laundry questions.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 permission informs A3 which towel; B4 preserved towel causes A5 future placement.

relationship.evidence: B2 helpful permission and B4 inaction give plausible uncertain signals.

heightening.evidence: A5 tests future belonging after learning the old object remains.

specificity.evidence: B4 hook and A5 guest laundry are specific relationship proxies.
